TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27. THE PHASE HALF IS CLOSED: the sim has the Late pass (hooks.py:36 `_PHASES`, resolved by `_each`) and this power uses it -- `modify_card_energy_cost_late`, powers.py:1221-1227 -- so it is guaranteed to run after Tangled's plain-pass `modify_card_energy_cost`, which is what FreeAttackPower.cs:14's TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate means. WHAT REMAINS is this record's own finding: THE PILE GUARD. FreeAttackPower.cs:26-39 zeroes the cost only when `card.Pile?.Type` is Hand or Play; powers.py:1221-1227 zeroes every Attack of the owner's wherever it sits, so a draw- or discard-pile Attack still displays as free to previews.py and the RL observation.

BeforeCardPlayed.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27, and the reason it stands has changed. `before_card_played` ITSELF now fires once per replay iteration (combat.py:576, inside the playCount loop) -- hook_dispatch G4 is fixed at the dispatch. But this power is hosted on `on_energy_spent`, which combat.py:497 fires ONCE per logical play, outside `_resolve_card_play` and therefore outside the loop (the auto-play site, combat.py:657, is likewise once). So a Throwing-Axe- or Duplication-doubled Attack still consumes TWO Free Attack stacks in the game (BeforeCardPlayed per iteration, CardModel.cs:1929) and ONE in the sim. The deliberate slot choice recorded here is now the SOLE cause of the count gap rather than a bystander to it, and the missing pile guard (FreeAttackPower.cs:48-59) is unchanged. VERIFIED by reading combat.py:470-506 and :574-600.
